fields.description: Issue includes an investigative report alleging abusive treatment of patients by Miami psychiatrist Dr. T. Earl Moore (the "Torture Doctor"), including the naming of Mildred Needleman and discussion of statute-of-limitations barriers and calls for action by the state medical board and Gov. Fuller Warren. Other coverage includes complaints about Florida Power & Light billing and electric rates; commentary on gambling enforcement and the proposed bookie-wire bill; local court items involving City Judge Cecil C. Curry; notices of cultural events (Freedom House Forum "Peer Gynt" and a fashion review at Booker T. Washington High School); political commentary on Florida figures (Pepper, Smathers) and masked-parade laws; horse racing statistics at Gulfstream Park and opposition to summer dog racing; and discussion of employment-agency rackets and "phony" charitable foundations used for tax avoidance.
